deviations: Every frame is DEMO, as §6.1's anatomy (L624): DEMO needs no arm (§3.6 L235), so no CMP-229 pill is drawn; the LIVE footers are row 4's (board 11), and on LIVE 'Retry TP 2' takes the same arm gate as Place (D16 L138), annotated on row 11.

G-T2 audit of this board: the gated controls are Details (rows 11 and 12; reason e32.details.unavailable) and row 13's Place (held until its Retry-After, 14:32:10; reason the refusal line bkt.stop_in_flight), each drawn as §3.6's T2 in CMP-079 RbacGate (lock glyph, full label in color.text.tertiary, raised fill with a color.border.default hairline, the reason in color.text.secondary under it); the busy Place (rows 8, 20) is §3.6's busy hold (CMP-001 loading), not T2 (L251-252); no role-gated control appears (DEMO, a trading role).
Focus 'stays' (rows 8 and 20) is drawn as the focus ring on the busy Place (Placing…), where the press that sent the request left it (§3.7 L264), as board 10 draws its twin frames.
Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
The anatomies' ASCII '->' (§6.1 L630, L636) is drawn as '→', the glyph of the keyed strings (e32.be.line L286; §3.4 L189).

Read-only inputs (§6.3 rows 8, 11, 20: 'inputs read-only') use the kit's read-only looks: fields field(state='readonly'), the side and type tabs and the unit switches segmented(state='readonly'), the trigger select(state='readonly'); the kit's stop_row() and target_section() take no read-only unit switch or trigger, so the generator swaps those two in (local helper). The radios and the breakeven checkbox keep their look (the kit has no read-only form for them); the frame's note says the inputs are read-only.

The one card (§6.3 rows 8 and 11: 'the one card forming (R1): entry, stop and targets indented, one status') is a CMP-118 AlgoProgressCard composition (§6.1 L647, the placing card) inside the modal, after the OCO slot and before the footer, so 'Retry TP 2' → 'Close' follow it (§6.5 L713; §3.7 L266-267). The spec keys no line of the card: its entry line is R1's header (D01:93, E30-D02 submit.label.limit, E30:412), the stop line R1's stop leg verbatim ('↳ Stop 63,900.0 · held by Bybit (exchange) · covers 0.250 of 0.250 filled', D01:93: quantity tracking is text), each target §3.4's R-mode line (L191; D9 L131: R leads on exits), TP 1 and TP 3 filled with §4.1's numbers (L338, L340), and under the targets D10's class word 'resting at Bybit, managed by CandleViewer' (§3.3 L178; A-11 L869: the bracket half names who holds each leg); legs indented by space.inset.lg; '(app-managed)' is CMP-118's always-visible word (§6.1 L647, OQ-4, A-14).
The busy state (CMP-001 loading, aria-busy; §3.6 L251-252) is the control's own look with the 'pending' glyph leading its busy label; E30-D02 D17's in-button progress bar is hi-fi.
A focus ring is a 2 px inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs padding, so it sits 2 px off the control and adds 4 px on each side to the layout (CMP-039).
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.

The acceptance toast (§6.3 rows 9, 10, 18: 'assertive, once (the toast)') is a CMP-045 Toast / Notification composition (`15` CMP-045, role='alert' for an assertive one) in greys, 400 px wide (a kit choice): the check glyph and E30-D02's accepted / accepted.partial words, which E30-D02 draws as SCR-060's banner and names 'the toast per SCR-060 … the banner's twin' (E30:280). CMP-045 is not in §6.1's component list (L645-648): a list gap for the owner.

Pointers (§6.3 rows 9, 12, 18, 19: 'the annotated pointer'; the invoker, rows 9, 10, 18) are drawn as board chrome on the frame's doc surface, never as redraws: SCR-063 is E32-S01's (#928) and SCR-060 E30's; a pointer's caption is chrome (type.ui.caption, color.text.tertiary), its card holds only the row's copy.

The invoker is drawn as SCR-060's 'Targets…' (§6.4 L695; A-20), the entry point that opens SCR-069 prefilled (D2); the modal opened with no draft returns focus to the chart, palette or hotkey origin instead (row 1, L670). Its look on SCR-060 is E30's: a secondary-button composition stands in.
Row 11 names 'Retry TP 2' and 'Close' only (L683; §6.5 L713): the footer draws Close alone; Place has no state in the row (e32.placing's Where is SCR-069 8 and 20, L306).

Row 11's bkt.partial ErrorState (CMP-027) sits under the card, before the footer, not under the header where §3.1 L153 inserts banners and the error summary: 'Retry TP 2' → 'Close' follow the card (§6.5 L713, row 11) and state controls insert after the region they act on (§3.7 L266-267), so the refusal and its Retry TP 2 follow the card they act on.

Row 13's Place is drawn as §3.6's T2 until 14:32:10, its reason the refusal line (bkt.stop_in_flight), though row 13 (L686) names no gate: the drawn answer carries a Retry-After, so the draft is re-sent only after it (§3.5 L212-213), a state gate under G-T2 (§3.6 L242; §3.7 L264-265: a control a state gates turns T2 and stays focusable), as the twin SCR-065 row 15 reads ('Place T2 (§3.6) until the time, its reason the refusal line', L583; board 09) and E30-D02 holds a transient refusal's action (E30:283). The kit's T2_REASON_KEYS does not register bkt.stop_in_flight, so held_place() (a local helper) adds the reason node under k.t2()'s control. Spec carry for the boards commit: row 13's What renders (L686) adds 'Place T2 (§3.6) until the time, its reason the refusal line', as SCR-065 row 15 reads.

Rows 13 and 20 draw §6.1's one-target draft (the rows name no draft; Place's full label is quoted only for it, L641), so the error frame and its outcome-unknown twin read side by side (§14 L933); rows 8 and 11 draw the ladder (row 8 'with the ladder').

Row 20's submit.awaiting is E30-D02's button text (E30:279); the row keeps Place's label 'Placing…' (e32.placing) and gives the line its own region (status, polite, once), so it is drawn as a status line above the footer.

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
